summary.text: Jon Zlotnik is a Democratic member of the Massachusetts House of Representatives for the 2nd Worcester District, which includes Ashburnham, Gardner, Templeton and parts of Winchendon.
The Legislature's committee listing shows him as Vice Chair of the Joint Committee on Community Development and Small Businesses.

paragraphs.text: The official biography page lists Zlotnik's education as Gardner High School and a B.A. in history from the University of Massachusetts Lowell.
The committee listing also shows him on the Joint Committees on Agriculture and Fisheries, Economic Development and Emerging Technologies, and Environment and Natural Resources.
